name: ch4_fig14_controlled_comparison
prompt: Title (top): "한 번에 한 조건만 변경" + smaller warm-grey "Controlled Comparison". Draw two unlabeled side-by-side condition cards. Each card has exactly four rows in the same order. The first three rows are "모델", "포도당", and "목적함수" and connect across cards with grey equality marks; their value cells are blank abstract blocks with no text. The fourth row is "산소": left value "열림" in green, right value "차단" in red. At right show only two output headings "성장률" and "분비 플럭스" over blank abstract comparison marks, with no bars or values. Add one red emphasis bracket around only the oxygen row. Do not label the cards as experiments and do not add strains, media names, objectives, or a change-variable label. FINAL RASTER OVERRIDE: make every large shape interior exactly the same uniform off-white as the background and communicate semantic color with a single-color outline only. Allow solid color only in tiny markers. Render as a stark SVG wire diagram with fills disabled, never as polished presentation art or glassmorphism. Within any object, every interior pixel must have identical RGB; a lighter center, darker edge, glow, or soft transition is total failure. HARD QA: every card, row, block, bracket, and mark has one perfectly uniform solid fill. No gradient, highlight, lighting, transparency, glow, bevel, shadow, or tonal variation anywhere. Keep all artwork at least 120 px from every canvas edge. Visible text is restricted to the exact double-quoted strings in this prompt; no other text, numbers, captions, or spreadsheet labels.
